title: compact credential fallback, polite-backoff and iterator safety for Go SDK
author: Lena Park
description:
Motivation: the Go SDK had several edgecases around long-lived streaming sessions where credential rotation + transient network blips caused iterator panics or double-retries. This PR introduces a compact credential fallthrough strategy (CredentialCascade) plus a small ergonomic iterator safety shim (IteratorResume/ResumeToken) and a polite-backoff policy tuned for typical Redwood hosted failure modes.

Goals: 1) avoid iterator crashes during credential swap and resume streams reliably; 2) provide a default lightweight fallback chain for credentials so callers do not need to wire multi-provider logic; 3) reduce noisy retries on transient 5xx spikes using a polite, capped backoff profile while preserving idempotency semantics for non-streaming calls.

What changed (summary): CredentialCascade - a small chain-of-responsibility credential provider that tries primary -> cached refresh -> delegated fallback and exposes a Clear() hint for tests and shutdown. IteratorResume - a tiny interface + helper that lets stream consumers capture a resume token and resume without replaying from the beginning (saves tokens + reduces rehydration latency). CompactFallbackShim - compatibility layer so older callers that passed a single TokenProvider get a reasonable cascade without code changes. PoliteBackoffProfile - default retry schedule for SDK high-level calls: short jittered backoff for first 3 attempts, then an exponentially capped backoff with maximum 8s.

Compatibility & ergonomics: The public API surface is additive. Existing TokenProvider implementations continue to work. The CompactFallbackShim is enabled by default when a single provider is given to the client constructor; clients can opt out and pass a fully custom CredentialCascade if they need more control.

Testing: unit tests for credential rotation and iterator resume, integration test against the local streaming test harness demonstrating resume after a simulated token swap and a network pause. Benchmarks ensure the new paths add <250ns on happy-path call init.

Docs & migration: updated CHANGELOG + docs/upgrade-go.md with examples for opt-out and how to construct CredentialCascade.

Related: ENG-4521 (streaming stability), SUP-9842 (customer incident where reauth caused stream resets).

release_notes: Add CredentialCascade (fallback chain), IteratorResume for stream resume without full replay, default PoliteBackoffProfile for client retries; small ergonomics improvements and examples. Clients can opt-out of CompactFallbackShim and provide a custom CredentialCascade.
